summary: KYC Gate Fix VERIFIED - After login as reviewer, Home and More pages do NOT show pre-KYC gate cards. The useEffectiveKycAccess hook correctly fetches /api/kyc/status and passes forceKycUnlocked to HomePage, MorePage, and WalletPage, preventing stale local user state from re-showing KYC gates when backend says approved.
critical_code_review_comments: useEffectiveKycAccess.js: Correctly fetches /api/kyc/status and checks for approved status, can_use_wallet, can_use_auctions, can_use_trade_center
App.js line 351-352: serverKycApproved from useEffectiveKycAccess is used to compute isKycVerified which is passed as forceKycUnlocked to pages
HomePage.jsx line 275: Receives forceKycUnlocked prop and uses it in isKycVerified calculation (line 319)
MorePage.jsx line 652: Receives forceKycUnlocked prop and uses it in isKycVerified calculation (line 664)
WalletPage.jsx line 122: Receives forceKycUnlocked prop and uses it in isPendingKyc calculation (line 127)
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC gate fix verified. The useEffectiveKycAccess hook fetches /api/kyc/status on authenticated user load and passes forceKycUnlocked=true to pages when backend reports approved status. This prevents stale local user state from showing KYC gates. Reviewer account shows full access to Home, More, and Wallet pages with no KYC gate cards.
